breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified that the detailed Strang splitting method was the intended one and omitted any mention of the conflicting 'Explicit forward Euler' method, thus successfully resolving the inconsistency.
